source_name: President of Iceland forseti.is + olafur.forseti.is Icelandic speech PDFs (Wayback/CDX)
leaders_covered: Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson; Guðni Th. Jóhannesson; Halla Tómasdóttir
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 2,882 Icelandic speech PDFs across TWO hosts - www.forseti.is/media (2,540 raw) and olafur.forseti.is/media (710 raw) - after excluding translated files. TEXT extracts 422-14,737 chars; DATE from the filename via url_regex on 4-digit-year files; TITLE from the PDF's first line (the Icelandic headline, e.g. 'Ávarp forseta Íslands...'). NATIVE-LANGUAGE companion to the live isl_forseti.yml, answering that recipe's OWN documented follow-up ('if the site only holds the incumbent (Halla, 2024->), Guðni Jóhannesson (2016-2024) needs a Wayback companion') - and it reaches further, back through Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson (1996-2016). Icelandic -> body lands in text_originlanguage and the translation stage fills English. Iceland uses the PER-PRESIDENT ARCHIVE SUBDOMAIN pattern (like the US whitehouse.archives.gov recipes): olafur.forseti.is is the frozen Grímsson archive (crawled 2024-2026, content 1996-2016). gudni.forseti.is is the third such subdomain but is HTML-only (649 captures) - see the follow-up below. WHY PDFs RATHER THAN THE NEWS HTML: forseti.is publishes each address as a PDF under /media/, which is where the full speech texts live; the archived HTML news stream spans three incompatible URL generations (/Frettir/Ollfrettin/<id> 2009-2016, percent-encoded /fr%C3%A9ttir/<slug>/ 2019-2025, and the current /frettir/<slug> which the live recipe already covers) and would need its own DOM pass - a worthwhile FOLLOW-UP, not this recipe. CAVEATS: (1) the store mixes ÁVARP/RÆÐA (addresses) with FRÉTTATILKYNNING (press releases) and occasional non-speech files (song programmes, 422-char notes), so 2,882 is an upper bound on rows, not speeches - the cleaner's document_type gate separates them. (2) 2-digit-year filenames are left UNDATED by design (YY.MM.DD vs DD.MM.YY is ambiguous and dateparser would confidently get it wrong); on olafur.forseti.is that is a large share, and wayback_capture is a POOR fallback there because it was crawled 2024-2026 while its content is 1996-2016 - so date_precision matters and the cleaner's corrected-date pass carries the load. (3) the ~155 *_enska-marked files on these native hosts are excluded here and are NOT picked up by the English sibling either (which reads only english.forseti.is), because a sampled one (olafur .00.04.13.Ossur.enska(1).pdf) extracted ICELANDIC - the marker is unreliable on these hosts; recovering them is a small optional follow-up needing a per-file language check. NO speaker_default (three presidents) -> tenure crosscheck. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
